after.zh: 凹坑检测台用的就是光度立体：几盏灯轮流打光，解出每一点的朝向，坑和划痕在朝向图里一目了然，漆色深浅完全不影响。手机拍证件、工厂查钢板表面，都有这样的做法。
after.en: This dent detector is photometric stereo at work: a few lamps light the part in turn, the facing at every point is solved, and dents and scratches stand out in the map of facings, whatever the paint does. Document scanning on phones and steel-sheet inspection in factories use the same approach.

t.zh: 检测仪的最后一关。金属板本该是平的，允许它轻微弯曲；磕出的坑和划痕会让表面明显倾斜。
t.en: The inspection machine's final level. A sheet should be flat, though a slight bend is allowed; dents and scratches make the surface tilt clearly.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：标出坡度超过 0.3 的地方，漆色深浅不能误报。
t.en: Your task in this level: mark where the slope is above 0.3; uneven paint must not raise an alarm.

caption.zh: 第三组测试：一个坑和一道划痕
caption.en: Set 3: a dent and a scratch

brief.zh: 同样的三盏灯。金属板本该是平的（允许轻微弯曲），磕出的凹坑和划痕都会让表面倾斜。标出倾斜得太厉害的地方：表面的坡度（法线水平分量的长度 ÷ nz）超过 0.3。漆色深浅不能误报。
brief.en: The same three lamps. A sheet should be flat (a slight bend is allowed); dents and scratches make the surface tilt. Mark where it tilts too much: where the slope (the length of the normal's horizontal part ÷ nz) is above 0.3. Uneven paint must not raise an alarm.

hint.zh: 上两关各求出了一部分。坡度只和朝向有关。
hint.en: The last two levels each worked out part of it. The slope depends only on the facing.
